findings.title: Content stays invisible after scrolling the whole page
findings.evidence: 4 text/image elements still have opacity≈0 after a full scroll: div.faq-list.reveal > details > div > p "No. Audio is analysed on your phone to detect breathing and "; div.faq-list.reveal > details > div > p "No. Drift works with just your phone on the nightstand. If y"; div.faq-list.reveal > details > div > p "Overnight sensing is lightweight. Keep your phone plugged in"; div.faq-list.reveal > details > div > p "No. Drift is a wellness app. It can't diagnose or treat slee".
findings.fix: A reveal never fired. Check the IntersectionObserver targets/threshold (use threshold ≤0.15 and a negative bottom rootMargin, not 1.0), that every hidden element gets observed, and gate the hidden initial state behind a class added by JS (`.js [data-reveal]{opacity:0}`) so content is never lost if script fails.

findings.title: Layout properties are animated
findings.evidence: 25 animations/transitions on width, left, top; 0 inline-style layout writes.
findings.fix: Animate transform and opacity (and clip-path for reveals) instead of width/height/top/left/margin; they run on the compositor and avoid reflow jank. For accordions use grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr or measure once and animate a scale/clip.

findings.title: Many elements loop forever
findings.fix: Limit ambient loops to one or two focal elements (a hero visual, a marquee). Constant motion everywhere competes with content and drains battery; pause off-screen loops.

findings.title: Tap targets are small on mobile
findings.evidence: section#top > a.scroll-cue 24×40, footer.footer > div.wrap.foot-grid > nav > a 160×24, footer.footer > div.wrap.foot-grid > nav > a 160×24, footer.footer > div.wrap.foot-grid > nav > a 160×24
findings.fix: Give touch controls at least 44×44px of hit area (padding or a pseudo-element hit box).

findings.title: Body text is small on mobile
Some sections are static
findings.fix: Consider a subtle reveal for these sections so the page keeps a consistent rhythm, or keep them deliberately calm if they are dense reading areas.

findings.title: A few text elements have low contrast
findings.evidence: "© 2026 Drift Sleep Labs. Drift is a well" 3.44:1, "Back to top ↑" 3.44:1
findings.fix: Raise contrast of these elements to at least 4.5:1.
